crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third…
But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked…
I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a…
“Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them…
He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb…
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…

parallels.note: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

translations.web: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
translations.bsb: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.
translations.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
translations.asv: And he questioned him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
